responsibility: Implements Darwin-specific C-family frontend behavior rather than generic Mach-O code generation. It registers and parses Darwin pragmas such as #pragma options align, #pragma unused, and #pragma ms_struct, manages Objective-C framework and include-path handling, defines Darwin preprocessor builtins like __APPLE__ and the deployment-target macro, and supplies C/ObjC target hooks for CFString construction, format recognition, and Objective-C class-reference assembly emission. This is the frontend-side companion to darwin.cc/darwin.h, focused on parsing, builtins, include search, and ObjC/C-family hooks.
